verdict.rationale: BAMF is a government migration and refugee agency with an informational web portal. Generating AI insights and suggestions from a user's own data is a data-product capability outside this kind of service. Nothing in the evidence shows BAMF ships AI features: the pack covers only informational sections, human service teams and the BAMF-NAvI integration-offer locator.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
